speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Yellowish discoloration of the skin. I also have Discoloration started from the face then spread to the trunk, Scleral icterus noted.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (also known as Breastfeeding Jaundice or Insufficient Intake Jaundice).

The clinical picture of a 5-day-old exclusively breastfed infant with a relatively low bilirubin level (7 mg/dL) and normal bowel habits rules out significant pathologic causes like biliary atresia or sepsis. The jaundice is likely due to insufficient milk intake leading to decreased stooling and reduced bilirubin excretion. No further immediate testing is required unless the baby shows signs of dehydration or poor weight gain. Continue to encourage frequent breastfeeding or supplement with formula to ensure adequate intake.
